typography.font_setup_instructions: Import 'Libre Baskerville' (400, 700) and 'Public Sans' (300, 400, 500, 600, 700) from Google Fonts in index.css or via Next/Font. Use font-serif for headings and font-sans for body.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-white

layout_and_spacing.general: Use generous padding (py-16 md:py-24) for sections. Elements should align optically.
layout_and_spacing.navigation: Sticky top bar, z-50, background #063462, text white. Links must smooth scroll to section IDs.
layout_and_spacing.hero: Split layout grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 min-h-[80vh]. Left side: bg-[#131e3d] flex flex-col justify-center px-8 md:px-16 lg:px-24. Right side: full cover image (no padding).
layout_and_spacing.services: CSS Grid layout. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Cards must have a white background, subtle 1px border (#e2e8f0), rounded-md shadow-sm. Padding p-8 inside cards.
layout_and_spacing.awards: Dedicated section. Dark navy background (#131e3d) or high-contrast white with copper accents (#9f6c5c). Centralize the award badge.
layout_and_spacing.client_feedback: Grid layout for testimonials, similar subtle styling as services.
layout_and_spacing.contact: Two-column grid for address/info and perhaps a map or image on the other side.

components_and_interactions.buttons: Primary CTA must be bg-[#9f6c5c] text-white hover:bg-[#8b5c4d] transition-colors rounded-sm px-6 py-3 font-semibold. Do NOT use default colors. Secondary buttons can be outline border-[#063462] text-[#063462].
components_and_interactions.modals: Use Shadcn UI Dialog for 'Submit a deal' (Form modal) and 'Leave Us A Review' (Links modal).
components_and_interactions.cards: Services and team cards use flat design with subtle border, maximum border-radius 4px or 8px (rounded-md). Avoid heavy shadows, keep it corporate.
components_and_interactions.animations: Subtle fade-in on scroll for sections. Hover states on buttons (color shift) and cards (slight -translate-y-1).
components_and_interactions.icons: Use lucide-react. Corporate standard size (w-6 h-6), color: #063462.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text over #9f6c5c and #063462 meets 4.5:1 minimum.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements, anchor links, and form submissions MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-services-link', data-testid='submit-deal-button').

hero_right_image.usage: Right side of the split hero section, object-cover, h-full.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global typography styles apply 'Libre Baskerville' to h1-h6 tags and 'Public Sans' to body text using standard Tailwind configuration.
Build a single-page application structure using standard Javascript (.js/.jsx), React, and Tailwind, with anchor links to different sections.

Implement the Header with sticky positioning, a z-index over 50, and `#063462` background color. Render navigation links to: Home, Our Services, Our Team, Awards and Recognition, Client Feedback, Contact Us.

Implement the Hero section as a split 2-column layout. The left column background MUST be `#131e3d` with white text. It should contain 'Powerhouse Title, LLC', a tagline, intro, and CTA buttons. The right column MUST be an image utilizing the provided `hero_right_image` url with `object-cover`.
Primary call-to-action buttons (Submit a deal) MUST exclusively use the copper/rust color `#9f6c5c`.

Implement 'Our Services' with exactly 5 cards (Title Insurance, Title Search, Escrow Services, Closing Services, Notary Services). Use a CSS grid. Include placeholder text or badges for residential, commercial, and refinancing focus areas.
Implement 'Our Team' section featuring 3 team members using the provided placeholder images.
Implement the 'Awards and Recognition' section to be visually distinct, using either the `#131e3d` or `#ffffff` background with `#9f6c5c` gold/copper accents. Use the provided `award_badge` url.
Implement 'Client Feedback' with 3 simple testimonial cards (Yelp, Google, General) and a 'Leave Us A Review' button.
Implement two Shadcn Dialog (Modal) components. 1. 'Submit a deal' modal with a placeholder form (Name, Email, Message, Submit). 2. 'Leave Us A Review' modal with Google and Yelp buttons.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the URLs provided in this JSON.
Ensure all buttons, links, and forms include appropriate `data-testid` attributes.
